spoken_summary: Donald Trump announces he is signing the "Secure America Act" to fully fund the Department of Homeland Security through the end of his term. He states this is to provide law enforcement with the resources to protect the borders and deport "criminal aliens." He adds that his administration has been removing dangerous people from the country since "day one."
